title: When the Vow Sings
author: Zephyrine Joubert
blurb: Gideon Yarrow, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
